## Post DocupletionForms submissions to Slack

![Workflow overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alfa-intellitech/n8n-nodes-docupletionforms/main/templates/images/new-submission-slack-notification.png)

**Uses the verified [n8n-nodes-docupletionforms](https://www.npmjs.com/package/n8n-nodes-docupletionforms) node — available on n8n Cloud and self-hosted instances.**

### Who's it for
Teams using [DocupletionForms](https://docupletionforms.com) who want their support/sales/ops channel notified the moment a form is filled out, instead of checking the DocupletionForms dashboard manually.

### How it works
The DocupletionForms Trigger node listens for the *Form Submitted* event on a form you choose. Every new submission fires the workflow, which formats the submitter's answers and posts them to a Slack channel.

### How to set up
1. Add your DocupletionForms API credential (API key + tenant ID).
2. Pick the Form to watch on the trigger node.
3. Add your Slack credential and choose the destination channel.

### Requirements
- n8n (Cloud or self-hosted) with `n8n-nodes-docupletionforms` installed — on Cloud, enable it under Settings → Community Nodes; verified nodes are approved for Cloud installs.
- A DocupletionForms account and API key.
- A Slack app/bot with permission to post in the target channel.

### How to customize
Swap the Slack node for Email/Teams/Discord, or edit the message text to include only the fields you care about — the trigger payload (form name, submission number, all answers) works the same way with any downstream node.

### Step 1
Set up your DocupletionForms credential, then pick the Form to watch below.

### Step 2
Set up your Slack credential and choose a channel. Customize the message text if you like.
